banner.title: shelfmark
banner.tagline: Searches for ebooks through Prowlarr, Usenet and direct HTTP sources, and drops renamed files into the Calibre-Web Automated ingest folder.

explainer.title: From a book request to a file in the ingest folder

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Shelfmark queries Prowlarr for Usenet releases and the Hardcover, Google Books and Moly metadata providers for the title.
steps.scene: a magnifying glass over a shelf of book spines

steps.title: Usenet
steps.text: A Usenet pick goes to SABnzbd in the books category. The file is saved on shared-downloads at the path SABnzbd reports.
steps.scene: a usenet packet moving into a download tray

steps.title: Direct
steps.text: Direct downloads come from Anna's Archive mirrors and LibGen search. Cloudflare-fronted pages go through FlareSolverr.
steps.scene: a globe with a shield wall and a downward arrow

steps.title: Rename
steps.text: Files are renamed to Author - Title (Year) and written to /cwa-book-ingest, the NFS ingest folder that Calibre-Web Automated reads.
steps.scene: a book with a renamed label card

steps.title: Check
steps.text: A read-only mount of the CWA library lets Shelfmark see which books are already held.
steps.scene: a library shelf with a checkmark
